name: @storytree/agent-pool
description: Agent runner (story_b2051c0f7372, ADR-1071 D3), once the dev loop's agent pool (ADR-1066 D2 G): the lane runner and its engine, the dispatcher, and the watcher that lands handed-over pull requests, configured by agent-pool.json at the repo root. packages/dev-loop/src/lanes keeps forwarders at the old paths the Mint box's live processes run.
